import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Safely format a blog entry for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the title and body inserted into BLOG_FORMAT, with all user supplied content properly escaped to avoid HTML injection (CWE‑74). Raises ------ ValueError If either headline or text is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise ValueError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise ValueError("text must be a string") # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent injection. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
